segments.contextAfter: `DNSDomainMatch` ([string]): An array of domain names. This rule matches if any of the domain names in the specified list matches any domain in the device’s search domains list. The system supports a wildcard (`*`) prefix. For example, `*.example.com` matches against either `mydomain.example.com` or `yourdomain.example.com`.
